WITH
    overlapping AS (
        SELECT
            h.haul_id,
            u.user_haul_id
        FROM
            (
                SELECT
                    u.user_haul_id,
                    u.period,
                    u.fiskeridir_vessel_id
                FROM
                    user_hauls u
                    INNER JOIN hauls h ON (
                        h.fiskeridir_vessel_id = u.fiskeridir_vessel_id
                        AND u.period && h.period
                    )
                WHERE
                    u.fiskeridir_vessel_id = $1
                    AND u.end_ts >= $2
                GROUP BY
                    u.user_haul_id
                HAVING
                    COUNT(h.haul_id) = 1
            ) u
            INNER JOIN (
                SELECT
                    h.haul_id,
                    h.period,
                    h.fiskeridir_vessel_id
                FROM
                    hauls h
                    INNER JOIN user_hauls u ON (
                        h.fiskeridir_vessel_id = u.fiskeridir_vessel_id
                        AND u.period && h.period
                    )
                WHERE
                    h.fiskeridir_vessel_id = $1
                    AND h.stop_timestamp >= $2
                GROUP BY
                    h.haul_id
                HAVING
                    COUNT(u.user_haul_id) = 1
            ) h ON h.period && u.period
    )
UPDATE user_hauls u
SET
    haul_id = o.haul_id,
    trip_id = NULL
FROM
    overlapping o
WHERE
    o.user_haul_id = u.user_haul_id
    AND u.end_ts IS NOT NULL
